variants.headline: Bid to remove government fails
variants.body: A vote to bring down the government has failed in {colony}. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Confidence challenge falls short
variants.body: The attempt to remove the government by an Assembly vote has failed. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Government survives the Assembly test
variants.body: The government has survived a vote intended to bring it down. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
